threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look bewildered when the bus driver yells 'Next stop, the Dalston Junction!' like it’s a secret you should already know.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken on the 59 last night; a couple shared their secret BBQ spot. Only in Brixton can a bus ride turn into a foodie guide.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids setting up a pop-up café in the park, serving handmade lemonade from a cart. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find spontaneous block parties that shut down the street—complete with local DJs, pop-up bars, and everyone just vibing.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their reaction to a loud bang—everyone else flinches, but we're just scanning for the nearest BART delay.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5 bus near Civic Center; a guy serenading us with a ukulele while we waited 20 minutes due to a 'dog on the tracks' incident. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí; they miss the tiny, quirky bars where locals swap stories over vermut, the real heart of the barrio.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they struggle with the 'mañana' concept, stressing about things that don't need urgency.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You order a latte and ask for it to be hot, not realizing 'hot' isn't a thing here—it's either lukewarm 'artisan' or boiling 'burnt'.
Spotted a guy on the N35 last night loudly singing opera, while everyone else was glued to their phones. Was surprisingly good, but he totally cleared the bus at Loughborough Junction.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw an entire family of ducks waddling across the busy Karl-Marx-Straße, completely unfazed by the chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it's normal to see spontaneous street concerts spring up near Görlitzer Park—guitarists and drummers just jamming, no one bothering to ask for permission.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they’re not phased by the Civic Center dog delays but can still name all the taco spots with late-night hours.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni at Civic Center yesterday—an artist was painting a mural right on the platform, totally brightened the delay!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to Park Güell, but they miss the hidden murals in the alleys. It's like they think art has to be on a grand scale to matter.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confused looks at the bus map; locals just know which stop to jump off at without a glance.
